name: Bhas Karmarkar
bio: Building on a strong foundation in high-precision machine automation, my ambition is to rethink what intelligent medical devices can achieve. I am driven to work where machines meet the human body—exploring mechanobiology, microrobotics, and haptics. My ultimate goal is to engineer human-machine interfaces that make life-saving technology simpler, more effective, and universally accessible.

experience.description: Leading advanced R&D in high-precision automation, with a core focus on dexterous robotics, laser processing, and Physical AI integration.

bullets: Advanced microrobotics research by improving ML-driven tracking by 10% — published in Advanced Intelligent Systems.
Designed mechanical models for acoustic polymer characterisation — published at MARSS 2024, Delft.
Conducted rheological V&V studies on viscoelastic polymers across dynamic frequency and temperature ranges.
Mentored a 6-member senior design engineering team on magneto-acoustic actuation projects.
Led end-to-end product development for a pilot-scale medical disinfection AGV from initial concept to production.
Engineered the chassis and app-integrated control system, redesigning core components to achieve a 15% cost reduction.
Integrated pneumatic controls with PLC systems across 3 automated subsystems for gantry and conveyor builds.
Redesigned critical mechanical components to streamline assembly, reducing the project timeline by 10 days.
Formulated a new resin mixture that achieved a 40% weight reduction in composite manufacturing parts.
Implemented a 3-step efficiency strategy resulting in 20% less downtime and 30% higher output.
